The Open Data Lab is built through the work of student researchers and contributors who develop original analyses using public data and reproducible workflows.

Each contributor represents part of a growing, public-facing body of civic data research—transforming coursework into published, portfolio-ready work.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## A Community of Contributors

Contributors to the Lab:

- explore real-world questions about New York City\
- analyze publicly available datasets\
- develop reproducible research using R and Quarto\
- publish their work as part of the Lab’s ecosystem

This model creates a collaborative environment where individual work contributes to a larger, evolving platform.

## Summer Internship Program

The Open Data Lab Summer Internship Program provides students with the opportunity to contribute to long-term, public-facing projects that extend beyond the classroom. Interns work closely with the Lab to develop open-source software, reproducible research, and analytical tools while gaining experience with collaborative software development, technical communication, and public scholarship.

Each internship track is designed around ownership of a meaningful project, giving interns the opportunity to create work that can be shared through GitHub, professional portfolios, conference presentations, and future research collaborations.

::: {#internships}
:::
